name: Dr. Priya Nair, MD
reviews: Dr. Nair diagnosed my lupus after years of unexplained fatigue and joint pain. She's a detective.
Compassionate and incredibly thorough with autoimmune conditions.
She listens to symptoms that other doctors brush off as being 'in your head.'
profile_text: Dr. Priya Nair is a board-certified rheumatologist focused on autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, including lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, Sjogren's syndrome, and other connective tissue diseases. She frequently evaluates patients with chronic fatigue that is accompanied by joint pain, inflammation, or other systemic autoimmune features.
guideline_text: Evaluation of fatigue with a possible autoimmune basis: screen with ANA, rheumatoid factor, anti-CCP, ESR, and CRP when fatigue is accompanied by joint pain, rashes, or elevated inflammatory markers. Autoimmune disease can cause anemia of chronic inflammation, which is distinct from iron-deficiency anemia and is diagnosed using ferritin (often normal or high) alongside inflammatory markers. Isolated iron deficiency without inflammatory features is outside rheumatology's primary scope and is better served by hematology.
